## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Type Of Change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] UI or UX improvement
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Infrastructure or tooling

## Why This Change

Explain the problem being solved, the goal of the change, or the user impact.

## Screenshots Or Recordings

If this changes UI, include before or after screenshots or a short recording. The easy way is [uploads.sh](https://uploads.sh): run `uploads put ./screenshot.png` on your branch and it lands in a comment here automatically, no files committed. Automatic posting uses the uploads.sh GitHub App on this repository; if it is not installed yet, run `uploads attach --promote` once your pull request is open. See [Show your changes](https://github.com/VecterAI/reacher-x/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#show-your-changes).

## Testing

List what you ran locally.

- [ ] `pnpm exec tsc --noEmit`
- [ ] `pnpm lint:strict`
- [ ] `pnpm exec prettier --check` on the files you changed
- [ ] `pnpm test:convex`
- [ ] `pnpm build`
- [ ] Manual verification

## Environment Or Schema Impact

Note any env var, schema, migration, webhook, integration, or deployment impact.

## Checklist

- [ ] I read `README.md` and `CONTRIBUTING.md`

## Notes For Maintainer

Anything you want me to know before review.
